_help: Each entry in `layers` becomes a globe layer fetched through /api/geofeed/feed-custom-<id>. Only https URLs listed here can be fetched. The upstream must return a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Custom layers appear under OTHER in the DATA LAYERS panel. Optional: name, color, icon, source, refreshMinutes (default 60), labelProperty, keyEnv + keyParam or keyHeader (the key is read from that env var on the server). Restart the dev server after editing.
